posts.name: tzgardner
posts.cooked:
I was looking for some ideas for helping to speed up the game.  (Please don't say to play faster.)  Some Villains seem to take longer than others to play.  Some games I've played took 2+ hours to get through.  Sometimes I'll be playing for over an hour and the Villain hasn't even taken a hit.

 

For me, the most fun games are the ones I can get though in an hour or less (Baron Blade, Ambuscade, etc)  The least fun for me are the ones that take over 2 hours (akash'bhuta is the one I particularly notice).  Please list any other Villains that seems to drag games out and give ideas how to speed it up but still be challenging.

 

I haven't tried it yet but reducing HP of the Villains comes to mind but not sure if it'll make the Villains too easy.

posts.name: j1hopki1
posts.cooked:
My game group plays Sentinels at our lunch hour every Friday. We have specified which villains are lunch villains and which are not. Here is our list of "lunch villains." They consistently play in an hour or less.

 

Baron Blade

Bomber Blade

Omnitron

Cosmic Omnitron

Plague Rat

Normal mode Ennead

Skinwalker Gloomweaver

Ambuscade

Dreamer

Iron Legacy

Kismet

 

You are certainly welcome to argue one way or another on the remaining villains. I agree that some games against Chairman are very quick. Some are extremely long. This list is just the ones that consistently finish in an hour.

posts.name: Donner
posts.cooked:
I played a game vs. Iron Legacy (IL) this last weekend that took an hour and a half.  Team was:

Sentinels, DW Setback, Scholar, Naturalist.

If Setback hadn't died early on, the Sentinals would have been toast.  As it is, he gave them an extra power each turn, and Naturalist removed Iron Legacy's Ongoings.  But yeah, usually IL games are 2 or 3 rounds. :D
